licenseCaveat: Per-pack CC0 claims checked against metadata in source repository; verify author/pack terms for production. These are converted GLBs, not necessarily original publisher binary files.
verification: 188/188 source/destination Git blob SHA and GLB v2 header verified at import; render QA pending.
sceneUsageRules: Visible map decoration is fictional and should not appear as real local venue/street condition.
Choose at most a context-specific hero and a complementary atmospheric accent, never automatically from stereotypes.
Music performances, menus, cuisine, venue events and real geographic detail require independent verification.
Suppress effects in navigation/focus mode if they affect destination pins, MBTA stops, walking/transit lines, labels, attribution or click targets.
Do not preload the entire catalog. Select and lazy-load per scene. Honor reduced motion.
thumbnailPolicy: Gallery preview thumbnails load from pinned source GitHub revision; thumbnails are NOT bundled with Vibenta. No additional images are fetched by runtime Scene Composer.
